options.touches: canopy and element layers: a rosette organ at the apex of an unbranched stem bearing pinnate fronds
options.summary: Give the generator the palm's crown: fronds borne only as a rosette at the apex of a thick unbranched stem, each frond one pinnate element with leaflets along a rachis. Covers apical-rosette and pinnate-frond; off by default so every shipped preset stays byte-identical.

options.touches: surface and organ layers: retained petiole bases clothing the trunk, basal leaflets modified as spines
options.summary: Add the two organs the packet finds no row for: persistent leaf bases as a 3D organ on the trunk (the diamond boots of a date palm) and acanthophylls at the base of each frond. Covers persistent-leaf-base and acanthophyll; off by default.

options.touches: organ layer: one hanging date cluster from the crown, in fn-33's reproductive organ slot
options.summary: Add the infructescence as its own organ: a hanging cluster from the crown. Covers infructescence only; the packet notes fn-33 (open) specifies one reproductive organ slot this would fill.

options.touches: canopy values only: tip clump and short shoots at the leader's apex standing in for a rosette
options.summary: Approximate the crown with existing rows: a large terminal clump and long short shoots at the apex, no new organ. Answers none of the five capabilities by name and the gate would still halt; listed so the route can weigh a no-generator path.
